title: Customers with no orders
prompt: Return the names of customers who have never placed an order (use a left join).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cust2 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cust2 VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'),(4,'Dave'); CREATE TABLE ord2 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, cust_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO ord2 VALUES (1,1),(2,1),(3,3);
reference_sql: SELECT cust2.name FROM cust2 LEFT JOIN ord2 ON cust2.id = ord2.cust_id WHERE ord2.id IS NULL;
